scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name wildfire-boundary-tracker --branch main
scripts.dev: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages dev dist --env-file .env.local
scripts.benchmark:cpp: node tools/run_cpp_benchmarks.mjs && node tools/compare_cpp_benchmarks.mjs benchmarks/cpp_baseline.json build/benchmarks/cpp-current.json --enforce
scripts.test: npm run build:pages && npm run typecheck && npm run test:cpp && node tests/run_tracker_tests.cjs
